query: INSERT IGNORE INTO leaderboard_snapshots (snapshot_date, season_id, scope_type, scope_id, user_id, `rank`, lp) SELECT ?, ?, 'GOVERNORATE', p.governorate_id, us.user_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.governorate_id ORDER BY us.season_lp DESC), us.season_lp FROM user_stats us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.user_id JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = us.user_id JOIN user_settings s ON s.user_id = us.user_id WHERE us.current_season_id = ? AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.calibration_ends_at <= ? AND s.show_on_leaderboards
